text:
ITEM 1 | Mound of finely curled, ruffled dark green leaves with frilly edges, mostly deep green with some lighter sage-green leaf blades and stems, covering roughly 30-35% of the square white plate, about 14 cm across by 13 cm tall in footprint, low and loosely piled (about 2-3 cm high), dry-looking with no visible sheen or liquid, sitting directly on the plate | 90

ITEM 2 | Small scattered pieces of golden-brown and tan granular bits (crumbly, irregular, about 0.3-0.5 cm each) mixed through the greens, with a slightly dry, matte, crunchy-looking surface, some clustered near the center of the greens | 8

ITEM 3 | Bright red pieces of chili-like material, irregular diced shapes about 0.5-1 cm, glossy-looking skin with dull seeded interior, scattered in 3-4 spots within the greens | 4

ITEM 4 | A few small loose green leaf fragments and crumbs scattered on the white plate to the right of the main mound, each about 0.3-1 cm, dry and matte | 2
